info.name: Garage Parts — Full Marketplace & Realtime API Collection
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman collection for Garage Parts Marketplace API.

### Included Modules & Workflows:
1. **System & Health Probes**: Health check, database/cache/queue probes, Laravel uptime, CSRF cookie initialization, remote migrations & seeding.
2. **Authentication & Session**: Registration (Buyer, Seller, Dealer, Parts Seller), Multi-role Login, Profile (`/auth/me`), Role-specific probes (`buyer`, `seller`, `dealer`, `parts_seller`, `admin`), OAuth redirect/callback, Single & All-device logout.
3. **Media Uploads & File Storage**: Upload single/batch high-resolution images & PDFs (AWS EFS & Local Storage ready), view, and delete media.
4. **Saved & Favorites**: Save/unsave cars & parts, fetch favorite IDs for fast UI badges, filtered queries, and clear favorites.
5. **Cars Marketplace (Public)**: Public vehicle catalog with multi-facet filters (brand, model, price, year, mileage, transmission), sorting, pagination, and detail specs.
6. **Seller Cars Inventory**: Seller vehicle creation, media gallery linkage, updates, draft/publish/sold workflow transitions, and deletion.
7. **Parts Marketplace (Public)**: Public automotive parts catalog with category, condition, free shipping, brand filters, and stock inspection.
8. **Seller Parts Inventory**: Seller parts creation, inventory quantities, pricing, compatibility list, workflow transitions, and deletion.
9. **Checkout & Orders**: Public/Customer order placement with line items, agent attribution, public order lookup by order number, and authenticated order history.
10. **Sales Agent Portal**: Public referral code verification, agent sales performance analytics, and payout configuration.
11. **Chat & Direct Messaging**: 1:1 user-to-user direct chat with listing context linkage, unread count badge, conversation listing, message history, read receipts, and automated PII sanitization engine.
12. **Real-time WebSockets & Broadcasting (Laravel Reverb)**: Channel authorization (`/api/v1/broadcasting/auth`) for `private-user.{id}`, `private-seller.{id}`, `private-conversation.{id}`, and `presence-marketplace` channels.
13. **Nginx FastCGI Edge Performance & Caching**: Microcache hit/miss validation and cache bypass checks.

### Automatic Variable Sync:
- Authentication requests automatically capture the Bearer `{{token}}` and `{{userId}}`.
- Creating a car or part automatically captures `{{carId}}` and `{{partId}}`.
- Creating an order or starting a conversation automatically captures `{{orderNumber}}` and `{{conversationId}}`.
- Submitting a seller application automatically captures `{{applicationId}}`.
